Network Title: Quebec – Ministère de l’Environnement, de la Lutte contre les changements climatiques, de la Faune et des Parcs, Climate Monitoring and Observer Stations Network

Domain: Weather

Network Type: Atmospheric: Surface and climate

Network Provider: Ministère de l’Environnement, de la Lutte contre les changements climatiques, de la Faune et des Parcs du Québec

Network Provider Website: https://www.environnement.gouv.qc.ca/index_en.asp

Station Automation: Mixed

Highest Sampling Frequency: Hourly

Data Feed Frequency: Twice a day or in Real time

Period of Operation (Seasonal or Continuous): Continuous

Number of Stations: 135

Category of Reported Elements: Temperature; Total Precipitation; Rainfall; Snowfall; Wind; Weather phenomenon observation

Data Access Points: https://www.environnement.gouv.qc.ca/climat/donnees/

Quality Assessed (Yes/No): Yes

Legal Constraints: https://www.quebec.ca/en/copyright
